properties.name: quote.service-uri
properties.description: Base URI of the upstream joke service, e.g. https://api.chucknorris.io.

properties.name: quote.service-path
properties.description: Path of the random joke endpoint on the upstream service.

properties.name: quote.connect-timeout
properties.description: How long to wait to connect to the upstream service.

properties.name: quote.read-timeout
properties.description: How long to wait for the upstream service to respond.
